column2: long voluminous dark brown wavy hair with a soft center part, falling over both shoulders and down the back to mid-back (it replaces and hides the small bun)
a sleek chin-length honey-blonde bob haircut with soft side-swept bangs (it replaces and hides the slicked-back hair and bun)
a pastel pink puff-sleeve crop top with a sweetheart neckline and a front lace-up detail, ending above the navel (it covers the bandeau bra)
a fitted plain white crew-neck t-shirt with short sleeves, its hem ending at the top of the hips (it covers the bra; the lower briefs stay as they are)
high-waisted wide-leg medium-blue denim jeans with a thin black belt, reaching down to the ankles; the bare feet stay visible and unchanged
a high-waisted black pleated mini skirt ending at mid-thigh (it covers the briefs)
a fitted black strapless mini cocktail dress from the chest to mid-thigh (it covers the bra and briefs)
a red satin slip dress with thin spaghetti straps and a V neckline, midi length ending just below the knees (it covers the bra and briefs)
chunky white platform sneakers with pastel pink details on both feet; legs unchanged
classic black patent pointed-toe high-heel pumps on both feet; legs unchanged
large thin gold hoop earrings on both ears; nothing else changes
a small light-beige smooth leather top-handle handbag with a gold turn-lock clasp, gold rings and one short rounded beige top handle.  (made with art-src/gen_bag.sh, in the hand of acc-belt-bag)
